messages:
milo: Mystery to report  there9s a sealed tin of shortbread in the pantry labeled "do not eat" but no name. Who's the guardian? Also the electric kettle is whistling funny  loud shriek at boil. Anyone else?
anya: Not mine. I vote we open the shortbread at 4:30 with tea and solve the mystery. :detective: Re: kettle  yes, it squeals sometimes, probably lime build-up. Can someone descale?
quentin: I can descale the kettle at lunch. If it survives revival I volunteer as tea pourer for the shortbread reveal.
sara: Shortbread reveal > morning standup. I'll bring fancy loose leaf for the ceremony. Also tiny PSA: please stop stacking lids on top of the microwave  they slip and land in someone's keyboard.
elie: Oof keyboard landings are traumatic. Also who borrowed the pastry tongs? I need them for a client snack delivery at 3.
milo: Pastry tongs belong to me  left in the utensil drawer. Sorry for the hide-and-seek. I'll put them on the counter now.
anya: Quick poll: crunchy snack preference for the shortbread party  butter biscuits, oat bars, or none? Vote ends 2001234600.
quentin: Butter biscuits please.
sara: Oat bars for allergies? We have guest with gluten sensitivity. Maybe pick something GF-friendly too.
elie: I'll pick GF oat bars. Also tiny kitchen etiquette note: if you heat up fish please vent the window and set a timer. We had a smell incident last week.
kitchen-bot: Poll created: "Shortbread party crunchy addition" options: Butter biscuits, Oat bars, None. Poll ends 2001234600. Reminder scheduled: "Descale kettle" at 2001238200.
milo: Also can we please stop using mismatched lids in the fridge? Suggestion: clear bin on bottom shelf labeled "leftover lids". Keep lids there, not on containers.
anya: Love the lids bin idea. I'll bring a small plastic bin from home at 5pm.
quentin: Note: coin jar update  $4.10. If everyone chips $1 we can buy a proper set of pastry tongs so no one hoards mine.
sara: I'll chip in $2. Also is anyone allergic to sesame? Ordering bagels next week and want to avoid surprise toppings.
elie: No sesame for me, thanks for checking. Seeded bagels okay if labeled.
milo: Great. Shortbread ceremony set for 4:30. Rules: label your mug, return tongs, and do not microwave mystery tins. :tada: 
anya: Also I'll tape a small sign on the kettle: "Descale monthly / ring Quentin if noise > normal".
kitchen-bot: Reminder: "Shortbread reveal + tea" 2001236600. Shopping list updated: GF oat bars, label stickers, clear bin.
